WITH per_item_town AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_item_id,
        c.town_city,
        AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
        AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
), town_averages AS (
    SELECT
        town_city,
        AVG(avg_price) AS average_price,
        AVG(avg_cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio
    FROM per_item_town
    GROUP BY town_city
)
SELECT
    town_city,
    average_price,
    average_cost_ratio,
    average_cost_ratio - AVG(average_cost_ratio) OVER () AS excess_over_cross_town_average
FROM town_averages
WHERE average_cost_ratio > AVG(average_cost_ratio) OVER ();
